> **registerEnv**\<`T`\>(`EnvClass`, `env`): `Promise`\<`T`\>

Defined in: [packages/env/src/registry/register-env.ts:19](https://github.com/NanoForge-dev/Engine/blob/ed8c7e0b33d17f8343c32659cf63ba4166a4fa53/packages/env/src/registry/register-env.ts#L19)

Validates a raw environment object against a `class-validator`-decorated
class and returns a populated instance.

## Type Parameters

### T

`T` *extends* `object`

## Parameters

### EnvClass

new () => `T`

A class decorated with `class-validator`/`class-transformer` decorators.

### env

`Record`\<`string`, `unknown`\>

Raw, unvalidated environment values (e.g. `process.env` or `InitContext.env`).

## Returns

`Promise`\<`T`\>

## Remarks

Callable from anywhere — inside a library's own `__init(ctx)` (reading
`ctx.env`), or from an app's `main.ts` before constructing the
application. Not tied to `@nanoforge-dev/core` in any way.

## Throws

`NfEnvValidationException` When validation fails.
